affected_party: QIF evaluators and organizations applying calibration knowledge across domains
actual_problem: Domain-local evidence can be pooled or reused across contexts even when constructs, populations, outcomes, evidence collection, thresholds, and confidence meanings differ.
why_it_matters: Unsupported transfer can produce false assurance at the exact loss boundary QIF is meant to protect.
why_now: v0.7.2 now preserves local outcome uncertainty, making cross-domain comparability the next unresolved calibration boundary.
